cards.typed_words: Book 1 spine/cover: "TOM JENSEN POEM ANTHOLOGY, 734 pages of poems" (rose photo cover), with a strip of small handwriting on the cover reading "(I need an entirely different... the lyrics to all...)". Book 1 intro page: "GOOD POEMS FOR MAKING SONGS - My poems and lyrics waiting for music are here. This section contains 200 of my poems that have not yet to be put to music as of the date of this printing. There is an alphabetical index of these poems at the beginning of the book. POEMS - More poems are here... This collection contains poems about all types of things and many of these will make for good songs too... however, be warned that some of these poems deal with serious subject matters and may contain explicit lyrics and reader discretion is advised. There is an alphabetical index of these poems at the end of this book. SEARCHABLE INDEX - If you download this book as a pdf file (from my website) then you can easily search for any word, phrase or title by typing it into the search box at the top of the document. This is great if you remember only a line of a poem and want to find it quickly and easily. My website is readtom.com. Do YOU readtom.com? ALL LYRICS (c) COPYWRITTEN BY TOM JENSEN. Date of this new collection is March 29th, 2013. My YouTube channel for songs is TUBESBESTMUSIC. Many of these poems can be found on my YouTube channel LYRICALBRILLIANCE. Enjoy!"
